{{Quote|The ''Starrunner''! I crashed that ship into the surface of Hoth and drove its crew to ruin!|Horak-mul, to Darth Nox|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
The '''''Starrunner''''' was a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] that belonged to a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] scavengers in the fourth millennium before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[3642 BBY]], the scavengers looted [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], removing [[Horak-mul's sarcophagus|the sarcophagus]] of [[Horak-mul]] from its grave and carrying it aboard the ''Starrunner''. The ghost of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], however, took his revenge by driving the ship's crew insane and forcing the ''Starrunner'' to crash on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
